overview: The picture follows one piece of work through a company: a salesperson's AI agent drafting a contract for a customer. It starts with experts writing down their rules and ends with both companies signing. Then it loops back to the experts so the rules can get better.

Every time the work crosses a line (between a person and an agent, between teams or between companies) it passes a gold gate. The gate checks the intent behind the work against the rules. Then it lets the work pass, pulls in a person to approve, or stops it. Each decision goes into the record with its reason.
The nine steps below follow the numbers on the picture.
govern_line: Govern is the gates and the record, running through the other four.
